title: Apply Performance and Observability Capstone
prompt: Complete the slow-app investigation end to end: baseline, diagnose, fix leaks, blocking and recomposition, add profiles, verify distributions, add CI guards and operate a staged release.
successCriteria: The start state, result, build, device, process or thread context, and public contract are explicit.
Evidence follows the complete ownership path and distinguishes direct cause from nearby correlation.
Failure, privacy, security, compatibility, regression, ownership, and recovery behavior are verified.
hints: Use matching AOSP or official documentation and two runtime evidence sources rather than memorising a diagram.
Change one controlled condition and predict which process, thread, queue, service, or buffer evidence should move.

starterCode.code: ./gradlew :benchmark:connectedReleaseAndroidTest # Archive distributions, Perfetto traces, profiles, artifact identity, and field gate definitions.

solutionOutline: Draw the responsibility sequence and capture a version-matched baseline or failure reproduction.
Exercise one adverse path, verify the causal fix or explanation, then preserve a regression guard and recovery record.
verification: Repeat the trace or telemetry capture from a documented starting state and retain raw evidence.
Test death, delay, denial, cancellation, backpressure, or configuration as appropriate to the boundary.
